interpretations.statement: Unreviewed interpretation: Authority, an applicable operative order and implementation are different propositions. Litigation, suspension, finality and repayment are not inferred from an order. These inputs do not replace contractual conversion conditions. Formal expressions: (and authority_preconditions order_issued order_applies_to_instrument (not order_suspended)); (and authority_preconditions order_issued order_applies_to_instrument (not order_suspended) loss_implemented)
